# Jose Diaz Tutoring

> Math, physics and engineering tutoring for high school and college students, taught by Jose Diaz, an engineer with more than 15 years designing electronics and firmware for medical devices and aerospace systems. One-on-one and small-group sessions, online from anywhere or in person in Broward and Miami-Dade counties (South Florida), in English or Spanish. The first 20-minute intro call is free.

## Subjects

High school (grades 9–12, including honors, AP and dual enrollment):

- Algebra 1 & 2, including Florida EOC prep for Algebra 1
- Geometry, including Florida EOC prep
- Precalculus & trigonometry
- AP Calculus AB & BC
- Physics & AP Physics 1, 2, C
- SAT & ACT math

College (math and physics for STEM, pre-med and engineering majors):

- College algebra & precalculus
- Calculus I, II & III
- Differential equations
- Physics I & II, algebra- or calculus-based
- Midterm & final exam reviews, one-on-one or in groups
- MCAT physics & math (the Chem/Phys section), for pre-med students

Engineering courses (for electrical and computer engineering students):

- Electric circuits I & II (DC, AC, transients)
- Digital logic design
- Programming (C, C++, Python)
- Microcontrollers & embedded systems

Tutoring for courses at FIU, FAU, Miami Dade College, Broward College, University of Miami and Nova Southeastern, plus high schools across Broward and Miami-Dade, and online students anywhere.

## Levels

- High school
- College
- College engineering courses

## Rates

Sessions are 60 minutes, online or in person. The intro call is always free. In-person sessions in Broward and Miami-Dade are the same price.

- High school, one-on-one: $65 per hour
- College, one-on-one: $90 per hour
- Engineering courses, one-on-one: $110 per hour
- Group exam review: $40 per student, per hour (3–5 students from the same course, 2-hour session before a midterm or final)
- High school, monthly plan: $429 for 8 sessions a month, same days and times each week (about $54/hour, save $91)
- College, semester plan: $899 for 12 one-on-one sessions scheduled around midterms and the final (about $75/hour, save $181)
- Engineering, semester plan: $1,099 for 12 one-on-one sessions in an engineering course (about $92/hour, save $221)
- Plans save about 17% compared with single sessions.

Plans are paid at the start. Monthly plans: unused sessions carry over to the next month, then expire. Semester plans are valid for the current semester. First-session guarantee: if a new student's first one-on-one session isn't worth it, they tell Jose within 24 hours and get a full refund, no reason needed (one per family; if they bought a plan, the whole plan is refunded). Two students together or a custom arrangement: ask Jose. Reschedule for free with at least 24 hours' notice; sessions cancelled with less notice are charged in full.

## Service area

- In person: Broward County and Miami-Dade County, Florida (at the student's home, a library or campus)
- Online: anywhere

## Languages

English and Spanish. Many students switch between both.

## Credentials

- Engineering degree from CUJAE (Universidad Tecnológica de La Habana José Antonio Echeverría, the Technological University of Havana); graduated 5th of 150
- 15+ years as an engineer in industry (electronics and firmware for medical devices and aerospace systems)
- Tutoring in the U.S. since 2016, from middle school through college

## Exam calendar

Free Florida test dates for the school year, each linked to its official source (FDOE, College Board, ACT, AAMC, college registrars), including the 2027 MCAT test dates. Dates are kept current without redeploying the site.

- [Florida exam calendar](https://josediaztutoring.com/exams/): every 2026–27 date for the Algebra 1 and Geometry EOC, SAT, ACT, AP and college finals in South Florida, plus the 2027 MCAT test dates, with what matters for each grade.
- [Calendario de exámenes de Florida](https://josediaztutoring.com/es/examenes/): the same calendar in Spanish.
- [Algebra 1 EOC guide](https://josediaztutoring.com/exams/algebra-1-eoc/): the passing score (400), the 2026–27 testing windows, other scores that meet the graduation requirement, and free official practice.
- [Guía del EOC de Álgebra 1](https://josediaztutoring.com/es/examenes/eoc-algebra-1/): the Algebra 1 EOC guide in Spanish.

## Free interactive tools

Interactive math, physics and engineering tools Jose made for his students (sliders, live formulas with the substituted values), each with a page that explains how to use it and the key ideas. Free, no sign-up, in English and Spanish. New tools are added without redeploying the site.

- [Free interactive tools](https://josediaztutoring.com/resources/): the library, filterable by subject and level.
- [Herramientas interactivas gratis](https://josediaztutoring.com/es/recursos/): the same library in Spanish.
